AUTHOR: Veiga
TITLE: Autonomous temporal pseudo-labeling for fish detection
REGION: Algarve coast, Portugal (target, CCMAR BRUV); source data OzFish, Australia
SPECIES: Single class 'fish' (Portuguese Atlantic coastal fauna; Australian fauna in OzFish)
DATA: OzFish (1753 frames, AIMS BRUV); CCMAR BRUV footage, 21 unlabeled videos (695 min) pseudo-labeled into up to 35,510 images (half negative samples); 383 marine-biologist-annotated test images
V_EV: Section 7: 'multiple underwater environments and conditions, including obscured scenarios with the suspension of sand, were used and tested, proving its versatility.'
D2: OzFish 80/15/5 train/val/test (unit not stated); CCMAR pseudo-labeled set evaluated on itself (split not stated); separate 383-image expert-annotated test set
D_EV: no statement found on the split unit; Section 5.2 only states OzFish images 'were divided into training, validation, and test subsets, following a ratio of distribution of 80%, 15%, and 5%'
R_EV: Table 1 vs Table 2: OzFish-trained YOLOv4 mAP50 68.46% on OzFish vs '48.60%' on 'the marine biologist-annotated images from different locations' (CCMAR, Portugal)
C_EV: Table 2 footnote: 'Confidence threshold at 50% on the left, and 10% on the right'; text: 'the direct relation between precision and recall with the variation of the confidence threshold.'
E_EV: Abstract/Section 6: 'The presented method achieved a mean average precision of 93.11% on our own data, and 73.61% on unseen data'
ARCH: YOLOv4 (also YOLOv4-tiny, YOLOv4-tiny-3l) with self-supervised temporal pseudo-labeling loop (Euclidean-distance tracker, confidence filtering, temporal frame thinning)
METR: mAP50, mAP75, average IoU, precision, recall at confidence 50% and 10%
NOTE: R1=Y because the OzFish (Australia) model is tested on Portuguese CCMAR expert-annotated images (different region, species, camera); R3 from OzFish in-domain mAP50 68.46% (Table 1) vs 48.60% on CCMAR GT (Table 2); the abstract's 73.61% 'unseen data' differs slightly from Table 2's 74.05%. Main CCMAR model is trained on pseudo-labels from the same 21 videos as the test images; whether the 383 'unseen images from different areas' come from videos/locations excluded from pseudo-labeling is not stated, so D1=NR. D3=Y for the 20-s temporal threshold 'to prevent over-similar images from the same sequences' (applied to pseudo-label selection). Pseudo-label confidence filtering is internal (P3), not C3. merged.json notes say 'OUT OF SLICE (2022)'; coded anyway as assigned. NIMG set to the largest pseudo-labeled CCMAR training set (half are negative samples).
